title: Persona analysis v1
description: `personas/<product>_analysis.json`, written by `eval personas discover --repo ... --save-analysis` (dokimi.personas.analyzer): the GitHub signals the persona generator is prompted with. Every list is empty when the repository could not be read.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

library_name.description: Only in an analysis made from a description (create_minimal_analysis).

description.description: The repository's description; null when GitHub has none.
